subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the platinum-blonde woman whose appearance and complete costume come from <Picture 2>: long voluminous wavy platinum-blonde hair, narrow black retro sunglasses, a black high-gloss patent-leather belted trench coat with lapels, a deep V neckline, a waist belt and a below-knee hem, and black pointed stiletto-heeled tall boots with slouched shafts. Her expression is cold and confident, and the orange firelight reflection across the patent-leather surface comes from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is the night fire scene from <Picture 1>: darkness filled with orange-red flames and rolling black smoke, with a strong orange light leak and flare along the right side of the frame.
<Subject 3> is the 90s analog broadcast treatment from <Picture 1>: film grain, VHS glitch tearing, CCTV scan lines, chromatic aberration, light leaks and slight camera shake, together with the on-screen broadcast overlay graphics that interrupt the picture.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a 15-second 16:9 fast-cut film-style fashion short in which <Subject 1> performs inside the night fire scene of <Subject 2> under the analog broadcast treatment of <Subject 3>. <Picture 2> supplies her appearance and complete costume, while <Picture 1> supplies the fire scene's atmosphere, texture and on-screen broadcast overlay. Neither image serves as a frame anchor, and no source video is edited or continued.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - her hair, sunglasses, patent-leather coat, boots and cold confident expression stay consistent in every shot, and the orange firelight reflection on the coat surface is retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the night fire scene, orange-red flames, black smoke and the strong right-side orange light leak are retained throughout.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - grain, scan lines, chromatic aberration, light leaks, slight camera shake and the broadcast interruption overlay are retained; the glitch peaks into a full signal break in [Shot 3] and then settles back into a steady analog texture.

detailed_description:
The target video is a fast-cut, film-style fashion commercial in 16:9 with a 90s analog look: heavy film grain and halation, scan lines, slight camera shake and hard cuts throughout, with the night fire scene lit by orange-red flames and a strong light leak from the right. The broadcast treatment defined in <Subject 3> runs across the whole video.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide shot frames <Subject 1> standing inside <Subject 2>, the patent-leather coat throwing the orange firelight back at the lens. The camera arcs right with small amplitude at slow speed as she steps forward through the smoke and turns her head away from the flames, her long hair lifting while the firelight reflection slides along the coat surface; dry embers drift past the lens, and the leather creaks with each step over the low roar of the fire.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.600, the shot cuts to a closer three-quarter angle as <Subject 1> finishes her stride and stops, lifting her chin toward the lens while the flames surge behind her and black smoke crosses the frame. Scan lines thicken across the picture, the color channels separate along her silhouette, the right-side light leak blooms brighter, and the frame shakes slightly; the flames surge with a deep whoosh, the smoke hisses, and a static current begins to rise under the ambience.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a tight close-up of <Subject 1>'s sunglasses and jaw as the analog signal collapses. The picture tears into horizontal VHS bands, chromatic aberration splits the highlights, and the CCTV overlay reading "BROADCAST: INTERRUPTION" snaps in across the top of the frame, fully inside the picture with clear margins, with the small marks "V" and "27" at mid-left and lower right. The interference peaks with a tape-tear burst, the fire drops to a thin ring, and the frame tears apart and blows out into a full-frame white that completely conceals the image.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.200, the white flash clears and the image resolves into a low-angle wide shot as <Subject 1> strides forward out of the flames, her open coat flaring behind her and firelight raking across the patent leather. The camera tracks with the stride at the same speed while embers sweep through the foreground, grain and scan lines carry over from the previous image, and the fire roar returns at full level with her footsteps on the ground.
[Shot 5] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up as <Subject 1> completes her step and stops, settling into a cold, confident look at the lens with one hand in her coat pocket. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed while the firelight keeps moving across the patent-leather shoulder; the frame shakes slightly and the grain and scan lines hold until the picture ends on her pose, with her footsteps stopping as she halts, the fire crackling steadily behind her and a single creak of the leather as she settles.

overall_soundscape: A steady night fire roar with crackling embers and a low airy rumble carries through the video, joined by the hiss of drifting black smoke and a thin layer of analog static that matches the picture's grain and scan lines. The scene keeps a dry, resonant night tone throughout, and the fire ambience continues without gaps after the broadcast interruption.

non_diegetic_music: A distorted analog synth bass loop at a fast tempo with clipped drum-machine hits and short tape-dropout gaps, running under the whole video and stopping on the final pose.
